policy_note: All values are synthetic. Group-level reachable_capacity_potential is not an allocation. Category totals count each facility once. No composite accessibility score is computed.

semantics.shortest_known_path: Only current network evidence, open edges and known step-free edges when required establish a known path.
semantics.shortest_possible_path: Unknown edge/step-free states may produce Unknown when no known path meets the group's budget; closed edges are never traversed.
semantics.service_usability: Opening window, eligibility, price and step-free requirements are filters. Unknown required fields produce Unknown, not a pass.
semantics.capacity: Only current capacity evidence with matching units contributes to known reachable capacity. Capacity is potential, not assigned supply.
semantics.aggregate_capacity: Each facility contributes once to its category's declared-open capacity total; group demands are summed separately. No allocation/rationing policy is implemented.
